title: fix(plugin-approvals, service-automation, service-messaging): title five system objects with a text formula instead of the raw id
body:
Fixes #20015

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

ADR-0079 resolves a record's title as `nameField`, then `displayNameField`, then a derivation. An explicit `nameField` takes precedence over the render-only `titleFormat`. The spec says so in the `titleFormat` describe (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2149` on `main`):

> [DEPRECATED → nameField (ADR-0079)] Render-only title template; the server cannot return or query it, and an explicit nameField now takes precedence. Migrate a single-field title to nameField, a composite to a formula field designated as nameField.

objectstack-ai/objectui#9436 makes the record page follow that order. Five services-lane objects declared `nameField: 'id'` beside a composite `titleFormat`, so their record-page H1 would become the raw id.

Each of the five now declares `display_title`, a formula field with `returnType: 'text'` that reproduces its `titleFormat`. `nameField` and the `displayNameField` mirror point at it. This is the migration the describe prescribes.

| Object | Formula (`display_title`) |
|:---|:---|
| `sys_approval_request` | `record.process_name + ' · ' + record.record_id` |
| `sys_approval_action` | `record.step_name != null ? record.action + ' · ' + record.step_name : record.action` |
| `sys_approval_approver` | `record.approver + ' · ' + record.request_id` |
| `sys_automation_run` | `record.node_id != null ? record.flow_name + ' · ' + record.node_id : record.flow_name` |
| `sys_http_delivery` | `record.label != null ? record.label + ' → ' + record.url : record.url` |

Where a source column is nullable, a row without it is titled by the other column alone, so the formula does not fail to evaluate.

- **No stored column.** A formula is virtual. `SqlDriver.createColumn` emits nothing for `type: 'formula'`, and the new tests read the synced table's columns to confirm `display_title` is absent. No migration runs.
- **`titleFormat` is unchanged** on all five objects, for renderers that still read it first. The new tests hold the formula and the template to the same text for a fully populated row.
- **`$search` is unchanged.** Neither `id` nor a formula is ever a search target (`SEARCH_AUTO_EXCLUDED_FIELDS`, `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`), so the lead and the membership of the auto-default set are identical.
- **No server-side sort reads the title pointer.** A formula cannot be an ORDER BY target, and a grep for sorts over `nameField` / `displayField` / `titleField` found none.
- The formula form follows the ADR-0079 worked example (`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`, `display_title` with `returnType: 'text'`) and the system-object import precedent for expression tags (`import { P } from '@objectstack/spec'` in `sys-permission-set.object.ts`). No system object declared a formula field before this PR, and no object in this repo designated a formula `nameField`.

## Census (re-run on `main` `9d81af714f`)

Every object definition declaring `nameField: 'id'` (all eight also declare `displayNameField: 'id'`):

| Object | File | Lane | `titleFormat` | H1 under ADR-0079 order, before | Verdict |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `sys_approval_request` | `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` | services | `{process_name} · {record_id}` | raw id | **changed** → `display_title` |
| `sys_approval_action` | `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-action.object.ts` | services | `{action} · {step_name}` | raw id | **changed** → `display_title` |
| `sys_approval_approver` | `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-approver.object.ts` | services | `{approver} · {request_id}` | raw id | **changed** → `display_title` |
| `sys_automation_run` | `service-automation/src/sys-automation-run.object.ts` | services | `{flow_name} · {node_id}` | raw run id | **changed** → `display_title` |
| `sys_http_delivery` | `service-messaging/src/objects/http-delivery.object.ts` | services | `{label} → {url}` | raw delivery UUID | **changed** → `display_title` |
| `sys_approval_token` | `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-token.object.ts` | services | none | raw id, same as today | left: no `titleFormat`, so the id is today's title too; no regression |
| `sys_flow_dispatch` | `service-automation/src/sys-flow-dispatch.object.ts` | services | none | raw dispatch key, same as today | left: no `titleFormat`; the dispatch key is the row's identity by design |
| `sys_migration` | `platform-objects/src/system/sys-migration.object.ts` | engine | `{id}` | raw id, same as `titleFormat` | reported, not edited (`domain:engine`): the template is the id itself, so no regression |

## Pointer pins, re-judged

- `service-automation/src/sys-automation-run-pointer-pair-verdict.test.ts` pinned `SysAutomationRun.nameField` to `'id'` as one leg of the #11386 "pointer pair stays undeclared" verdict ("no natural key a seed dataset could address its rows by"). **Re-judged, not dropped.** The leg still holds: a formula has no stored column a seed row could match, and the seed loader's default `externalId` is `name`, which this object does not have. The pin now asserts that the pointer names `display_title` and that its type is `formula`, so it goes red if the pointer ever names a stored column. The object's own comment carrying the same leg is updated to match.
- No other test pins these objects' pointers. `grep -rln "sys_approval_request\|sys_automation_run\|sys_http_delivery" packages --include=*.test.ts` finds 37 files in 15 other packages. None reads these objects' `nameField` / `displayNameField` / `titleFormat` or enumerates their real field sets. They use hand-built fixtures or mention the names in prose.

## Tests

New, one per package, each through the real `ObjectQL` engine on in-memory SQLite and the real object declarations:

- `plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-display-title.test.ts`
- `service-automation/src/sys-automation-run-display-title.test.ts`
- `service-messaging/src/objects/http-delivery-display-title.test.ts`

Per object, each test asserts:

- `resolveDisplayField` resolves `display_title`;
- a seeded row read back with `findOne` carries the H1 the `titleFormat` intended (for example `flow:deal_desk · opp_42`), and that H1 is not the row's id;
- the H1 equals the `titleFormat` rendering of the same row;
- the server-side accessor `resolveRecordTitle` agrees;
- the nullable-column leg titles the row by the other column;
- `display_title` is absent from the synced table's columns.

Runs at `a02c8673d7`:

| Suite | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, full (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`) | 50 files, 785 tests passed |
| `@objectstack/service-automation`, full | 145 files, 1729 tests passed |
| `@objectstack/service-messaging`, full | 45 files, 483 tests passed |
| `typecheck`, all three packages (incl. the `check:test-typecheck` ledgers) | exit 0 |

`tsc --listFiles` confirms every new test file is inside a typecheck program: service-messaging `tsconfig.json`, plugin-approvals `tsconfig.test.json`, and service-automation `tsconfig.test.json` and `tsconfig.json`.

### Ablations (committed state, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven blob == HEAD)

The object files are imported relatively from source, so no `dist/` sits on the resolution path and no rebuild is involved.

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| ptr-request | `nameField: 'display_title'` → `'id'` | red 2/5: `expected 'id' to be 'display_title'`; `expected '1noNVpCJW8_iN7Aq' to be 'flow:deal_desk · opp_42'` |
| ptr-action | same | red 2/5: H1 `'9kMVUkyx9hCJHlrr'`, expected `'approve · manager_review'` |
| ptr-approver | same | red 2/5: H1 `'CQJXqZmwf6e_0vl4'`, expected `'role:finance · N3bOxv5ejSt1FZj9'` |
| ptr-run | same | red 4/8, including the re-judged pointer-pair pin (`expected 'id' to be 'display_title'`) |
| ptr-http | same | red 3/4: H1 `'JNhfRQXBccs860NR'`, expected `'order.created → https://hooks.example.com/in'` |
| col-request | `Field.formula(` → `Field.text(` | red 3/5, including `expected [ 'id', 'created_at', …(20) ] to not include 'display_title'` |
| col-run | same | red 5/8, including the stored-column pin |
| col-http | same | red 4/4, including the stored-column pin |

Every leg printed `ok mutation landed` before its run and `ok restored: blob == HEAD` after it. The post-batch tree was clean.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` from the real diff derived 62 families. All 62 were run, and `--ran` reconciles: "62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (six unrelated packages had no `dist/`). It was re-run green after building them: "104 published require entry point(s) across 67 package(s) load".

Also run:

- `check:i18n-coverage`: OK, 621 baselined, none new;
- `GITHUB_TOKEN="$GH_TOKEN" node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`: exit 0;
- narrowed eslint over the 17 changed `.ts` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 17 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 ignored. The config never enables type-aware linting (`eslint.config.mjs`, around line 328), so a file's verdict depends on that file alone. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

The derivation noted the tree is a few commits behind `origin/main`. The one stale input is `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, and this diff adds no fake engine.

## i18n

`display_title` label and help are extracted into the plugin-approvals (request, action) and service-messaging bundles, and translated by hand in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. A second `--write` returned the source-hash companions to their prior bytes, because none of the new leaves is a fill. `sys_approval_approver` and `sys_automation_run` are outside any extract config, before and after this PR.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding for the seat (not filed from here): 19 objects declare `titleFormat` with no pointer, and the registry stamps `nameField: 'id'` on them.** Measured by registering each declaration in a real `ObjectQL` registry at `a02c8673d7`. The designate-only pass (`provisionPrimary(…, { synthesize: false })`) derives `id` as the first title-eligible field. A body served by a `/meta` read carries that stamp (`packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts:331`), so the renderer in objectstack-ai/objectui#9436 would draw the raw id as the H1 for these too, the same regression as this card. The 19 are, by lane:
  - `platform-objects`: `sys_account`, `sys_business_unit_member`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member`, `sys_scim_group_member`, `sys_scim_projection_grant`, `sys_scim_subject`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_two_factor`, `sys_verification`;
  - `plugin-approvals`: `sys_approval_delegation`;
  - `plugin-security`: `sys_position_permission_set`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_user_position`;
  - `service-messaging`: `sys_notification_delivery`, `sys_notification_preference`, `sys_notification_receipt`, `sys_notification_subscription`;
  - `service-realtime`: `sys_presence`.

  Not fixed here. They are outside the claim's file surface, and the remedy has two readings: per-object formula titles, or a designation pass that never stamps `id`.
- Six more no-pointer objects get a non-id field designated, so their H1 moves to that field's value: `sys_attachment` → `file_name`, `sys_report_schedule` → `name`, `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` → `permission_set_name`, `sys_record_share` → `object_name`, `sys_share_link` → `label`, `sys_notification_template` → `subject`. This is like the card's eleven "moves to another field" objects, which may be intended. Noted only.
- `Clause-②: no` is carried from the claim. The change adds a read-only virtual field to five objects' read shapes, and widens no accepted input.
